dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical 2D narrowing from the maximum mid-body width toward the posterior peduncle, with the distal extremity obscured by water surface turbulence.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Mainly smooth lateral margins; minor irregular deviations on the right lateral edge consistent with water-to-skin boundary interference.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to off-white; high median pixel intensity consistent with a sub-adult or near-mature individual.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse patches of darker grey pixels concentrated around the cranial region and along the central dorsal ridge.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; low-gradient transitions between pigmented patches and the dominant light-grey baseline canvas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Several thin, longitudinal linear marks of slightly higher contrast visible on the left dorsal plane.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Defined longitudinal dorsal ridge creating a distinct shadow-casting boundary on the right side of the central axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of faint, linear epidermal scratches or rake marks on the left mid-dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct, dark circular aperture at the cranial-dorsal position corresponding to the blowhole.
